title: Matplotlib: plotting with Python · topic quiz

questions.prompt: Which function shows the part-to-whole shares of three categories?
questions.explanation: `ax.pie` shows part-to-whole shares; keep the number of slices small.

questions.prompt: Which chart groups sensor temperatures into bins to show their distribution?
questions.explanation: `ax.hist` groups numeric values into bins and shows their counts.

questions.prompt: Which chart is suitable for a possible relationship between two numeric measures?
questions.explanation: `ax.scatter` shows two numeric variables as points; association does not prove causation.

questions.prompt: Which chart compares the median and spread of several groups?
questions.explanation: `ax.boxplot` compares medians and spread using quartiles.
